postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Universal DataBase Sep. 2025 list, updated 20 August 2026, includes Benin among countries which do not require postal codes. The November 2025 UPU Benin addressing sheet uses a two-digit delivery-office identifier to the left of a P.O. box, locality and telephone number without a postcode. A delivery-office identifier, P.O. box, agency, department, commune, arrondissement, locality, telephone number, AGID value or synthetic planning code is not a Benin postcode.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Country, department, commune, arrondissement, locality, office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, square/house, street, quarter, arrondissement, delivery-office-and-box object, locality, telephone and country as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postcode into domestic addresses.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: The two digits before BP identify a delivery post office in specified cities; the BP number is a P.O. box. Neither is a postcode or postal area.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may return independently typed address context only under source-specific rights; they must never manufacture a postcode or postal surface.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. BJ planning cells and search-result IDs are not La Poste assignments or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Reviewed La Poste du Bénin and UPU pages are reference evidence. Website All Rights Reserved and UPU copyright/database restrictions do not grant AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights for a postal dataset.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO BJ identity and Benin's territory; do not borrow codes or geometry from another jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, box holders, customer addresses, parcel observations, telephone numbers, coordinates, buildings and query logs remain excluded absent explicit authority and minimisation.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent; preserve retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or an official announcement.

stages.definition: Benin address-format inventory and unverified four-digit assumption only.
Digest-bound La Poste du Bénin and UPU evidence that Benin currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, address format, delivery-object and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative La Poste du Bénin or competent public release establishing a Benin postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every assignment, delivery-office identifier distinction, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current UPU evidence says Benin does not require postcodes; absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Country, department, commune, arrondissement, locality, address, agency, delivery-office identifier, P.O. box, route, service area, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell and synthetic BJ planning code are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BJ API/app, handling no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, failure and invalid geometry states, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search, and display of code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BJ metadata, no-postcode policy, current delivery-office/P.O.-box and civic-address field semantics only; no real BJ Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual BJ loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Benin postal polygon. Independently licensed address or administrative context remains typed and source-qualified.
